enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Do not ignore TE0 or TE1 errors

enumeratedValue.description: SDR read from this target or an IBI is being pushed out

field.name: HDRMATCH
field.description: High Data Rate Command Match Flag

enumeratedValue.name: NONE
enumeratedValue.description: NONE (no event or no pending event)

enumeratedValue.name: NO_REQUEST
enumeratedValue.description: NO_REQUEST (request is not sent yet; either there is no START condition yet, or is waiting for Bus-Available or Bus-Idle (HJ))

enumeratedValue.name: NACKED
enumeratedValue.description: NACKed (not acknowledged, request sent and rejected); I3C tries again

enumeratedValue.name: ACKED
enumeratedValue.description: ACKed (acknowledged; request sent and accepted), so done (unless the time control data is still being sent)

field.name: ACTSTATE
field.description: Activity State from Common Command Codes (CCC)

enumeratedValue.name: ASYNC_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: ASYNC_MODE (Asynchronous standard mode (0 or 1) is enabled)

enumeratedValue.name: BOTHSYNCASYNC
enumeratedValue.description: BOTHSYNCASYNC (both Synchronous and Asynchronous modes are enabled)

field.name: URUNNACK
field.description: Underrun and Not Acknowledged (NACKed) Error Flag

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: No TE0 or TE1 error occurred

enumeratedValue.name: HALF_WORD
enumeratedValue.description: Halfword (16 bits) (this value ensures that two bytes are available in the FIFO)

enumeratedValue.name: TRIGGRONELESS
enumeratedValue.description: Default (trigger when 1 less than full or less)

enumeratedValue.description: Hardware, but the I3C module instance handles ID 48b

enumeratedValue.description: ID Instance is a register; used if there is no PARTNO register

enumeratedValue.description: A Device Characteristic Register (DCR) is available

enumeratedValue.description: A Bus Characteristics Register (BCR) is available

enumeratedValue.description: Static address is fixed in hardware

enumeratedValue.description: Hardware controls the static address dynamically (for example, from the pin strap)

enumeratedValue.description: SCONFIG register supplies the static address

enumeratedValue.description: The I3C module manages events, activities, status, HDR, and if enabled for it, ID and static-address-related items

enumeratedValue.description: The I3C module manages maximum read and write lengths, and max data speed

In Parallel mode, FLSHA1CRx register setting is applied to Flash A1 and B1, FLSHA2CRx register setting is applied to Flash A2 and B2. FLSHB1CRx and FLSHB2CRx register settings are ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. When an AHB bus cacheable read access occurs, FlexSPI does not check whether it hit the AHB transmit buffer.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. When an AHB bus cacheable read access occurs, FlexSPI first checks whether the access hit the AHB transmit buffer.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. For all AHB write accesses (bufferable or nonbufferable), FlexSPI returns AHB Bus Ready after transmitting all data and finishing command.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. For AHB bufferable write access, FlexSPI returns AHB Bus Ready when the arbitrator grants the AHB command. FlexSPI does not wait for the AHB command to finish.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB read burst start address alignment is limited when flash memory is accessed in parallel mode or flash is word-addressable.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB read burst start address alignment is not limited. FlexSPI fetches more data than the AHB burst requires for address alignment.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Suspended AHB read prefetch resumes when AHB is IDLE.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Suspended AHB read prefetch does not resume once aborted.

enumeratedValue.name: val0

enumeratedValue.name: val1

enumeratedValue.name: LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are not allowed

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are allowed

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables secure checking. Violation can be detected when the security level of a transaction does not meet the security rule of the slave or memory to be accessed.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables secure checking. Even if the security level of a transaction does not conform to the security rule of the slave or memory, it will not be detected as a violation.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables the privilege checking of secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables the privilege checking of secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables the privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables the privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ABORT
enumeratedValue.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will not cause an abort, but a secure_violation_irq (interrupt request) will still be asserted and serviced by ISR.

enumeratedValue.name: ABORT
enumeratedValue.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will cause an abort.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBTM
enumeratedValue.description: Master can access memories and peripherals at the same level or below that level.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBSM1
enumeratedValue.description: Master can access memories and peripherals at same level only

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: IDAU is disabled, which means that all memories are attributed as non-secure memory.

enumeratedValue.name: LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are not allowed

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are allowed

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables secure checking. Violation can be detected when the security level of a transaction does not meet the security rule of the slave or memory to be accessed.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables secure checking. Even if the security level of a transaction does not conform to the security rule of the slave or memory, it will not be detected as a violation.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables privilege checking of secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables privilege checking of secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables privilege checking of non-secure mode access is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ABORT
enumeratedValue.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will not cause an abort, but a secure_violation_irq (interrupt request) will still be asserted and serviced by ISR.

enumeratedValue.name: ABORT
enumeratedValue.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will cause an abort.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBTM
enumeratedValue.description: Master strict mode is disabled/off and can access memories and peripherals at the same level or below that level

enumeratedValue.name: AHBSM1
enumeratedValue.description: Master strict mode is enabled/on and can access memories and peripherals at same level only

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: IDAU is disabled, which means that all memories are attributed as non-secure memory.

enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are pre-enabled and ready to execute conversions without startup delays (at the cost of higher DC current consumption). field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

enumeratedValue.description: Match an ID value within a range of values, inclusive

register.description: ITRC outputs and IN0 to IN15 Status

field.name: IN7_STATUS
field.description: Secure violation interrupt (Memory Block Checker (MBC) interrupt or secure AHB (AHBSC) matrix violation, and SYSCON XEN violation).

field.name: IN9_STATUS
field.description: SPC VDD_CORE glitch detect event occurred.

field.name: IN10_STATUS
field.description: PKC module detected an error event.

field.name: IN113_STATUS
field.description: FREQME out of range status output.

field.name: OUT2_STATUS
field.description: OUT2_STATUS can initiate PoR reset. CORE domain is reset completely. System domain must be reset completely, except the registers in SPC which reset by PoR. VBAT domain is not affected. .

field.name: OUT3_STATUS
field.description: ITRC triggered RAM_ZEROIZE to clear retention and PKC RAM contents.

field.name: OUT4_STATUS
field.description: ITRC triggered CHIP_RESET to reset the chip after all other response process finished.

field.name: OUT5_STATUS
field.description: ITRC triggered TMPR_OUT0 internal signal connected to various on-chip multiplexers.

field.name: OUT6_STATUS
field.description: ITRC triggered TMPR_OUT1 internal signal connected to various on-chip multiplexers.

field.name: IN16_STATUS
field.description: SPC VDD low voltage detect event occurred.

field.name: IN20_STATUS
field.description: VDD_MAIN clock tamper output event occurred.

field.name: IN32_25_STATUS
field.description: IN25_STATUS - SOCTRIM0_ERR to SOCTRIM7_ERR OR together; IN26_STATUS - Reserved IN27_STATUS - ERM Multibit Error Interrupt IN28_32_STATUS - reserved

field.name: IN34_STATUS
field.description: SPC VDD_CORE high voltage detect event occurred.

field.name: IN35_STATUS
field.description: SPC VDD high voltage detect event occurred (SPC_VD_STAT[VDD_HVDF]).

field.name: IN37_STATUS
field.description: VBAT OFF (vbat0. iso_vbat_to_1p8v OR VBAT Detector Status).

field.name: INTID
field.description: Interrupt ID of the interrupt to trigger, in the range 0-479.

register.name: AIRCR
register.description: Application Interrupt and Reset Control Register

field.name: VECTCLRACTIVE
field.description: Reserved for Debug use. This bit reads as 0. When writing to the register you must write 0 to this bit, otherwise behavior is UNPREDICTABLE. This bit is not banked between Security states.

field.name: SYSRESETREQ
field.description: System reset request. This bit allows software or a debugger to request a system reset. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW if SYSRESETREQS is 0. When SYSRESETREQS is set to 1, from Non-secure state this bit acts as RAZ/WI.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_REQUEST
enumeratedValue.description: Do not request a system reset.

field.name: SYSRESETREQS
field.description: System reset request, Secure state only. The value of this bit defines whether the SYSRESETREQ bit is functional for Non-secure use. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure State and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is available to both Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_ONLY
enumeratedValue.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is only available to Secure state.

field.name: PRIGROUP
field.description: Interrupt priority grouping field. This field determines the split of group priority from subpriority. This bit is banked between Security states

field.name: BFHFNMINS
field.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI Non-secure enable. The value of this bit defines whether BusFault and NMI exceptions are Non-secure, and whether exceptions target the Non-secure HardFault exception. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure-state and RO from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI are Secure.

enumeratedValue.name: NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: BusFault and NMI are Non-secure and exceptions can target Non-secure HardFault.

field.name: PRIS
field.description: Prioritize Secure exceptions. The value of this bit defines whether Secure exception priority boosting is enabled. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure state and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SAME_PRIORITY
enumeratedValue.description: Priority ranges of Secure and Non-secure exceptions are identical

field.name: ENDIANNESS
field.description: Data endianness bit. This bit is not banked between Security states.

field.name: VECTKEY
field.description: Register key: Reads as 0xFA05. On writes, write 0x5FA to VECTKEY, otherwise the write is ignored. This Field is not banked between Security states.

register.name: SCR
register.description: The SCR controls features of entry to and exit from low-power state.

field.name: SLEEPONEXIT
field.description: Indicates sleep-on-exit when returning from Handler mode to Thread mode. Setting this bit to 1 enables an interrupt driven application to avoid returning to an empty main application. This bit is banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_SLEEP
enumeratedValue.description: Do not sleep when returning to Thread mode.

enumeratedValue.name: SLEEP
enumeratedValue.description: Enter sleep, or deep sleep, on return from an ISR

field.name: SLEEPDEEP
field.description: Controls whether the processor uses sleep or deep sleep as its low-power mode. This bit is not banked between Security states.

field.name: SLEEPDEEPS
field.description: Controls whether the SLEEPDEEP bit is only accessible from the Secure state. This bit in only accessible from the Secure state, and behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Nonsecure state. This bit is not banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit is accessible from both Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_ONLY
enumeratedValue.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Non-secure state.

field.name: SEVONPEND
field.description: Send Event on Pending bit. When an event or interrupt enters pending state, the event signal wakes up the processor from WFE. If the processor is not waiting for an event, the event is registered and affects the next WFE. The processor also wakes up on execution of an SEV instruction or an external event. This bit is banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: EXCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
enumeratedValue.description: Only enabled interrupts or events can wakeup the processor, disabled interrupts are excluded.

enumeratedValue.name: INCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled events and all interrupts, including disabled interrupts, can wakeup the processor

register.name: SHCSR
register.description: System Handler Control and State Register

enumeratedValue.description: Debug monitor exception is not active.

register.name: TYPE
register.description: The MPU Type Register indicates how many regions the MPU support. Software can use it to determine if the processor implements an MPU.

field.name: SEPARATE
field.description: Indicates support for separate instruction and data address maps. RAZ. Armv8-M only supports a unified MPU

field.name: DREGION
field.description: Number of regions supported by the MPU. If this field reads-as-zero the processor does not implement an MPU.

field.name: HFNMIENA
field.description: Enables the operation of MPU during HardFault and NMI handlers

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: MPU is disabled during HardFault and NMI handlers.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The MPU is enabled during HardFault and NMI handlers.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Disables the default memory map. Any instruction or data access that does not access a defined region faults.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enables the default memory map as a background region for privileged accesses.

field.name: REGION
field.description: Indicates the memory region accessed by MPU_RBAR and MPU_RASR.

field.name: XN
field.description: The XN bit is an Execute Never bit, that indicates whether the processor can execute instructions from the region.

enumeratedValue.name: EXECUTE
enumeratedValue.description: Execution is only permitted if read permitted.

field.name: AP
field.description: The AP[2:0] bits indicate the access and privilege properties of the region.

field.name: SH
field.description: For Normal memory regions, the S bit indicates whether the region is shareable. For Strongly-ordered and Device memory, the S bit is ignored.

field.name: BASE
field.description: Contains bits[31:5] of the lower inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is zero extended to provide the base address to be checked against.

field.name: ATTRINDX
field.description: Attribute index. Associates a set of attributes in the MPU_MAIR0 and MPU_MAIR1 fields.

field.name: LIMIT
field.description: Limit address. Contains bits[31:5] of the upper inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is postfixed with 0x1F to provide the limit address to be checked against.

field.name: XN
field.description: The XN bit is an Execute Never bit, that indicates whether the processor can execute instructions from the region.

field.description: Contains bits[31:5] of the lower inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is zero extended to provide the base address to be checked against.

field.name: ATTRINDX
field.description: Attribute index. Associates a set of attributes in the MPU_MAIR0 and MPU_MAIR1 fields.

field.name: LIMIT
field.description: Limit address. Contains bits[31:5] of the upper inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is postfixed with 0x1F to provide the limit address to be checked against.

field.name: XN
field.description: The XN bit is an Execute Never bit, that indicates whether the processor can execute instructions from the region.

enumeratedValue.name: EXECUTE
enumeratedValue.description: Execution is only permitted if read permitted.

field.name: AP
field.description: The AP[2:0] bits indicate the access and privilege properties of the region.

field.name: SH
field.description: For Normal memory regions, the S bit indicates whether the region is shareable. For Strongly-ordered and Device memory, the S bit is ignored.

field.name: BASE
field.description: Contains bits[31:5] of the lower inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is zero extended to provide the base address to be checked against.

field.name: ATTRINDX
field.description: Attribute index. Associates a set of attributes in the MPU_MAIR0 and MPU_MAIR1 fields.

field.name: LIMIT
field.description: Limit address. Contains bits[31:5] of the upper inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is postfixed with 0x1F to provide the limit address to be checked against.

field.name: ATTR0
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 0.

field.name: ATTR1
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 1.

field.name: ATTR2
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 2.

field.name: ATTR3
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 3.

field.name: ATTR4
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 4.

field.name: ATTR5
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 5.

field.name: ATTR6
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 6.

field.name: ATTR7
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 7.

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Enable. Enables the SAU. This bit is RAZ/WI when the Security Extension is implemented without an SAU region.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURED_MEMORY
enumeratedValue.description: Memory is marked as Secure and is not Non-secure callable.

field.name: SREGION
field.description: SAU regions. The number of implemented SAU regions.

register.name: RNR
register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Number Register

register.name: RBAR
register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Base Address Register

field.name: BADDR
field.description: Base address. Holds bits[31:5] of the base address for the selected SAU region. Bits[4:0] of the base address are defined as 0x00.

register.name: RLAR
register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Limit Address Register

field.name: NSC
field.description: Non-secure callable. Controls whether Non-secure state is permitted to execute an SG instruction from this region.

field.name: LADDR
field.description: Limit address. Holds bits[31:5] of the limit address for the selected SAU region. Bits[4:0] of the limit address are defined as 0x1F.

field.name: ADDRESS
field.description: When the SFARVALID bit of the SFSR is set to 1, this field holds the address of an access that caused an SAU violation.
